## Training Tiers
- Tier 4 — Board & CXO: Emerging Tech Horizon Briefing. 2 hours, live, remote, one board or leadership team. Quantum, post-quantum crypto risk, AGI trajectory, ASI predictions, How to Survive the AI first world, Migrating a Non-AI company to AI. INR 50,000 per session.
- Tier 3 — Executive AI Programme: 8–10 leaders, GenAI strategy plus hands-on Copilot/Claude/Gemini workflows, 6 hours, ending in a deployed workflow per participant. INR 25,000 per session.
- Tier 2 — Engineering Team: 1 day, remote, agentic AI, local LLM deployment, Claude Code and TDD workflows, with AI tools. INR 20,000.
- Tier 1 — Individual 1:1: Topmate, INR 10,000 for 2 hours. Training in Generative AI, SLMs, LLMs, Claude Code, AI-assisted work, Local LLMs.
